title: Every spectral subset of the cyclic group of order p squared times q times r tiles, for distinct primes p, q and r
author: Gábor Somlai
difficulty_reason: After the precise prior cyclic spectral/tiling reductions, positive prime-coset decomposition, cube rule and Coven--Meyerowitz tiling criterion, the author still proves a modular projection lemma and combines it with a complete cardinality analysis. The coupled spectrum graphs and projected coset restrictions must simultaneously control the p-squared coordinate and both other prime directions to force a tiling. That residual structural classification is nonroutine rather than direct cyclotomic substitution, giving a conservative H1.

Ordinary named prerequisites are Coven--Meyerowitz [1, Theorem B1 and (T1)/(T2) sufficiency]; Kiss--Malikiosis--Somlai--Vizer [9, Section 4 Reduction 1, Proposition/Corollary 3.4] under the exact source-stated proper subgroup/quotient hypotheses; positive two-prime coset decomposition as source Lemma 3.4; Shi [13] and Malikiosis--Kolountzakis [12] for the proper cyclic group cases; and Kolountzakis--Matolcsi [5, Theorem 2.1] for cardinality at most five. Full new cube-coset lemma 3.5, modular projection lemma 3.6, both spectrum graph arguments and every main cardinality case are retained.
